title: b7z9.25.b: wire hold-off expiry to desync+rejoin (R-02a-043)
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a 2a.5.3/2a.6, R-02a-043): after 3-superframe hold-off the node MUST initiate desync+rejoin, but advance_holdoff()==True is only a signal wired to nothing. Python: python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:48,359-376; Rust: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:840,1108-1122. Deliverable: the production FSM/timer owner consumes the hold-off expiry and performs desync + rejoin initiation, with tests asserting the rejoin fires at the hold-off boundary in both languages.
close_reason: DONE (Rust side of R-02a-043): holdoff_complete_rejoin(now_sf) -> bool added to MultiRootState (rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs) mirroring the Python holdoff_complete_rejoin exactly - not-in-holdoff -> false; otherwise the old root is dropped (current_root None), candidates cleared, holdoff counter/selection reset, desync_state_version invalidated, rejoin_sf recorded (new accessor). Tests: holdoff_complete_rejoin_drops_old_root drives the PUBLIC flow (current root + differing candidate -> process_beacon_window defers with holdoff=3 -> two advance_holdoff(false) -> holdoff_complete_rejoin(42) true with root dropped) and holdoff_complete_rejoin_not_in_holdoff (false). Also in this commit: the ccp16_desync_vectors.rs consumer (from the earlier round's work) completed with the two remaining vector-pinned multi-root assertions (NoChange negative control, Accepted path sfn_reset + desync-state clearing). Suite: lichen-rpl 323 passed / 0 failed (6 in this file); fmt + clippy clean. Scope note: the Python side already had holdoff_complete_rejoin (slot_coordination.py:410-426); the Rust port completes the R-02a-043 consumption primitive - the production driver that CALLS it per superframe boundary is the integration layer tracked under the parent b7z9.25/b7z9.12 family.
